name: vibesdk-db-llm-usage
description: DynamoDB-backed LLM usage tracking (tokens/cost/errors per request) for aws/agent-runtime's inference calls, powering GET /api/user/{id}/analytics and GET /api/agent/{id}/analytics -- an AWS-native replacement for the original's Cloudflare AI Gateway GraphQL analytics query, which has no AWS equivalent. Not part of the main vibesdk build.
